label: Podkvasa
note: A kefir-like soured milk, made without grains (Table 2 of one review only)

about.text: A kefir-like drink of Bulgaria, made from sheep's milk by spontaneous fermentation with mesophilic lactic acid bacteria and yeasts.

how.text: Fermented spontaneously, without kefir grains, by mesophilic lactic acid bacteria and yeasts; the review names no species (Table 2 only).

sources.text: The table, the facts and the words on how it is made, from these.
